status: Physics V3 configuration; awaiting regeneration verification and GPU smoke test

training.epoch_policy: Method B: every clean primary background once in an expanded fixed NPZ, lower maximum epochs to 60; early stopping 7 remains active.

experiment_policy: Run the baseline first. Ablations are explicit separate experiments, not an automatic search. Never select by challenge Test or leaderboard fitting.
loss: share MSE + explicitly logged auxiliary losses
ensemble: Fit nonnegative sum-to-one weights on inner predictions only, freeze before outer evaluation. No outer-fitted affine calibration.
final_assessment: Calibration and sealed sources remain outside this CV. Outer CV becomes development evidence after model comparison; it is not an endlessly reusable final holdout.

gpu.ram_note: 31GB offered; sequential models only, 64GB preferred when available; actual server measurements pending.

dataset_policy: Original inner/outer NPZ frozen byte for byte; train support cap, reference-only EQ and clean-pool blending; evaluate full and boundary-excluded OOF. Reference support cap plus maximum synthetic added/background minute SNR 20dB; requested/effective targets recorded.
